turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The underlying principle being cited by the Presiding Officer will be Section 21E of AM No. 24-1102 by the Supreme Court prohibiting the use of cellphones, tablets, or some other similar gadgets during video conferencing by analogy. Also, basis would be the U.S. case of Villarreal v. Texas wherein a witness must provide his own account rather than one scripted or choreographed by any party, council, or any interested party. Also citing the case of Sky Development Inc. v. VistaView, docket number 3D101274 of the U.S. Supreme Court. Accordingly, no witness while testifying shall possess, have access to, or use any earpiece, headset, cellphone, smartwatch, smart glasses, or any other similar device. Capable of transmitting or receiving information or communication. Witnesses are also prohibited from receiving or attempting to receive any communication, suggestion, answer, signal, message, or prompt for any person, whether inside or outside this court, regardless of the means employed. The prohibition shall remain in force during recesses and until the witness is formally discharged by the court. Consultation on unrelated matters, the use of any necessary medical accessibility, interpretation, or other device shall be subject to the court's prior approval. The clerk, therefore, is hereby directed to inform each witness of these directives prior to testifying, number two, secure all prohibited communication devices in the witness's possession before he or she is sworn in, and number three, to obtain the witness express confirmation on the record that he or she understands and shall comply with this directive. Any violations shall be brought to the attention of the chair and dealt with accordingly under the court's disciplinary powers. The directive shall take effect immediately and shall apply to the witness henceforth this court will be receiving. So ordered.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: because we conducted the Youth Leadership Summit in coordination and with the help of all the stakeholders. And we had our own problems in our area of operations 2023.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: During that time, we just had the bombing in Marawi City. So frankly speaking, we had more, at least for us, more important things.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Okay lang po ba yun sa inyo? Argumentative, Your Honor. Move on, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: What explanation did DepEd officials,

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: naalala niyo po kung ano yung paliwanag ng DepEd officials, yung binigay nila dun sa hearing kung saan kayo nag-attend?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Call for hearsay, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Dun sa issue na ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Call for hearsay, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Well, anyway, we'll just confront the witness with the video. You

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: may do so, counsel. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: We request that we play, we be allowed to play your honor, exhibit P-1- Roman numeral number 1-1-6, part 6, starting at 17 minutes 43 seconds to 27 minutes 16 seconds. Technical, can we play video number 2?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Directed.

turns.speaker: Rep. Joel R. Chua
turns.text: Indulgence. With the indulgence of Congressman Flores,

turns.speaker: Rep. Joel R. Chua
turns.text: Congressman Acop, the chair recognizes Congressman Acop.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: I would just like to ask some clarificatory questions regarding the interpolation of the Honorable Wistro.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: May no who can answer me? Sino ang makakasagot? Kanino bang program itong sinasabi natin na Youth Leadership Summit? Is it a program of the DepEd? The Armed Forces of the Philippines? Kanino?

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Sino ang makapagsasabi sa akin?

turns.speaker: Rep. Joel R. Chua
turns.text: Major General Bajao?

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: Bajao, Sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Joel R. Chua
turns.text: Bajao? May Ipirecognize, Mr. Chair. Ipirecognize.

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: Your Honor, it's a Philippine Army-wide program, a three-day activity po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: It's an activity included in the budget of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, tama? Yes,

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: It's one of the PPAs insofar as your budget is concerned.

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: Yes, Sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: So in other words, when you conduct these events, You do not need the help of other agencies or the funding of other agencies.

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: I would disagree with that, Your Honor, because we can only spend for our own troops, but the need of other participants and the subject matter experts have to be carried by participating agencies. What

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: is the legal basis why the program of the Armed Forces of the Philippines is participated on by other agencies of government. What is the legal basis?

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: Your Honor, we just operate in the context of the Peace and Order Councils. Our participation in the POC would also reflect on the participation of other agencies when we conduct this activity, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Direct question, Nalan General. Did you receive any funds from the confidential funds of the OVP in the conduct of these events?

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: No, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: Maj. Gen. Adonis R. Bajao
turns.text: No, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: There's no funds coming from, there are no funds coming from the Office of the Vice President. Yes, sir. No funds coming from them. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: May I ask Yusek Mempin?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Joel R. Chua
turns.text: Yusek Mempin, you are recognized.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Why would certifications be addressed to you?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, as I mentioned a while ago, I was asked by the Office of the Secretary to get a report from the Office of the Secretary.

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: who in the Office of the Secretary asked you that?

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Hindi namang pwedeng magsalita yung office of the secretary, di po ba? So there must be somebody from the office of the secretary who asked you to do that. And may I know who that is?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: It's our former chief of staff.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: And who might that be?

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: And who might that be?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Former USEC attorney Mike Powa po, sir. The

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: USEC Powa? Would you agree to the answer of the USEC MP?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Mr. Chair, Congressman Acop, yes, I confirm that. That you

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: asked him to ask for the certifications from the different unit commanders of the Philippine Army?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: If I may explain, Your Honor, the answer is yes.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: tama yung sagot sa akin ni

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Yusec Memphian,

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: na

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: kayo po ang humingi sa kanya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Your Honor, I request the technical to pause because I have a question or two for the witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Colonel, narinig niyo po yung usapan dun sa naging hearing. Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: In your case, sino po ang humingi nung certification?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: I was directed by our then commander. of the 1st Infantry Tabac Division, Major General Viray, to draft the certification. He was called by USEC Undersecretary, Med Pincer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So more or less tama po yung pinag-usapan dito? Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: It's according to what you experienced? Yes, sir. Okay. So can we proceed with the playing of the video?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: How many more

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: minutes is that, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: About 3 or 4 minutes, Your Honor. Proceed.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: na humingi siya ng certification doon sa mga units ng Philippine Army na nag-conduct ng YLS.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honor, if I may qualify, hindi po specifically on YLS. What I asked for was for any accomplishment kasi po yung ayon doon sa AOM na natanggap namin. Pag nagbigay daw po ng rewards, you needed evidence of success of the information you received from the rewards. I mean, you received through the giving out of rewards. So, because of this, I coordinated with Usec Mempin to provide any proof of accomplishment para po doon sa rewards na na-disburse ng confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Thank you. May I ask, you have been in the Army, Yosec Menfin, di ba?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, Mr. Chair. Ano po ang part ng

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: programang wireless na may kasamang rewards?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Could

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: you please tell me which part of that program would require the giving or the awarding of rewards?

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Which part of the program would require

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: the gathering of information. Kasi yun po yung purpose ng confidential fund ng DepEd. Apat po yun.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Now, which part of this?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, for the conduct of YLF per se, there's no... in that particular, any areas of that for the rewards, giving of rewards, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Basahin ko man ng ilang beses yung programa na yun, walang nagsasabi doon na pwedeng gamitin yung confidential fund ng isang agency. Would you agree with me?

turns.speaker: Nolasco A. Mempin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Yes. So, Yosef Pua, mali po yun.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Kasi kitang-kita naman na natin eh, that you asked for these documents to support your liquidation insofar as the Confidential Fund of the Department of Education is concerned.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Kasi hindi naman kaya basically primordial nakasama doon po sa mga events na iyon eh. And yet, you are submitting or you submitted to COA documents to support your liquidation of the Confidential Fund of the Department of Education. Wala eh. Kahit na anong basa ko.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Kasi, for your information, Yosef Powa, naging controller ako ng pulis eh. Kaya alam ko kung ano ang sinasabi nitong mga membro ng Philippine Army ngayon eh.

turns.speaker: Rep. Romeo M. Acop
turns.text: Alam ko rin na ginagamit nyo lang yun para i-justify yung expenditure nyo ng confidential fund ng Department of Education.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, can you already pause it here?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: to justify. Attorney Ray. Your Honor, just one minute more, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: This

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: is already Congressman Acop speaking.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. There was an answer. I don't want to end it here because if I remember, there is a response from USEC POA and I don't want to cut it here because makasabihin po nila pinuputol ko yung sagot niya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Mag-object na nga si Attorney Lindon. Anyway,

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Your Honor, I can end it here.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: End it here, counsel. You can present this part when you call or after you call Attorney Poa, if you want.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Well, Your Honor, I don't know what the objection of counsel would be but we can address it because the only reason that these are not accepted as proof of the truth is if the respondent will have no opportunity to present the witness to correct, Your Honor. These are senior personnel of the DepEd. They are senior aides. And they were making public statements under oath, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, counsel. But we are dealing with Colonel Boransing here.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: He has no relation anymore to the statements of the late Congressman.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: I was just going to ask him in relation to the explanation given by DepEd, in relation to the certification issue, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, counsel. I think he has heard enough in relation to that.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Sige

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: po. Ang pagkaka, kung nakapanood niyo po, Colonel, ang paliwanag po noong USEC ng DepEd na sinasabi niya na hiningan daw po sila ng certification, nagkaroon ng AOM, hiningan sila ng proof ng success noong paggastos nila ng reward at naisip daw niya yung certification nyo kasi nakalagay doon na may coordination ng DepEd, baka daw po sakaling nagamit yun at yun ang naging nabigay sa inyo yung information dahil sa kanilang confidential information, confidential operation, at yun ang dahilan kung bakit niya in-attach yung certification doon sa sagot sa AOM.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, can the prosecution be directed to just ask the question?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly simplify the question, counsel. I know where you're getting at. Ask the question directly.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Sige po. I'll just... Okay. Let me just ask a few preliminary questions before I ask our ultimate question, Your Honor. Colonel, para lang po sa kaalaman ng lahat, tanong ko lang po, ano po yung area ng operations ng 1st Infantry Division?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Currently, sir, or 2023, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yung pong 2023?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: The area of operation of the 1st Infantry Division during 2023 are the provinces of Lanao del Norte, Lanao del Sur, Zamboanga del Sur, Zamboanga del Norte, Zamboanga Sibugay, Misamis Occidental, and parts of Misamis Oriental, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: I understand that's called Zamboanga Peninsula?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ngano po katagal na kayong naka-station dyan, yung unit niyo?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: I couldn't, I'd have to look at the historical records for the specific date but I think the 1st Infantry Division transferred there after I think late 70s or early 80s, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: dekada na po?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So, siguro kung late 70s or 80s, mga 50 years?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So you

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: have been embedded there for 50 years. Ang tanong ko po, kung mayroon pong ahensya ng gobyerno na magko-conduct ng intelligence or confidential information sa area of operations nyo, ano po ba yung karaniwang SOP?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: May I clarify sir, SOP of the army or the police?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ano po yung SOP na ginagawa ng mga ahensya ng gobyerno? Lalong pag sila ay magko-conduct ng intelligence or confidential information sa area ng kagaya niyong army unit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Speculative, incompetent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: No, Your Honor, I'm just asking about this standard operating procedure, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: The witness is supposed to know, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: The prosecution is asking the SOP of other agencies, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: No, I'm asking the supposed SOP of other agencies.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: are you leading at counsel? Still in relation to the document being submitted as part of DepEd's liquidation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. In relation to the explanation given by the DepEd during the hearing on 17 October 2024.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the indulgence of counsels. Colonel Boransing, sinumiti po, sinimuti po ng DepEd bilang bahagi ng sagot nila sa AOM, yung certification na pinirmahan po ninyo, maliban doon sa ibang certifications na in-stipulate kanina, bilang patunay na naging matagumpay yung kanilang confidential operations. Una, nalalaman niyo po ba yan?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: No, sir. I am not an intelligence officer, sir. So, I'm not privy to any intelligence officers.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pangalawa. Binanggit nyo po kanina na walang binigay at wala kayong tinanggap na pera mula sa DepEd. Wala rin binigay na pera ang DepEd sa AFP o sa 1st Infantry "Tabak" Division o sa unit ninyo. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But would you know if DepEd spent on that activity on their own people because you collaborated with DepEd on that activity? Would you know? Sabi nyo kanina kasi KKB eh.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir. What I know is they arrived there. They were there during the youth leadership summits and traveling, as I know in the government, entails expenses and permission to leave the post, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Alam niyo ba na confidential funds ang ginastos para dun sa expenses na iyon o hindi pa?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: I have no knowledge about the source of funds, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So you can confirm that no money was given to the AFP or any of its units or...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: anyone for anyone in your unit but that DepEd must have spent money on the activities.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: I can only speak for the 1st Infantry "Tabak" Division Philippine Army, sir. No funds were downloaded to our specific unit, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But it is very possible that DepEd spent on the YLS and the IECs.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Final question. Did you spend intelligence or confidential funds for these activities on the part of the AFP?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Or

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: was this part of your regular programming, as you said earlier, chargeable against your regular budget?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: It's part of the regular budget, sir. But if I may explain, sir, so that the...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may, sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: The conduct of the Youth Leadership Summit is part of the campaign, sir. So it involves civil-military operations, combat operations, and intelligence operations. Although I cannot comment about the intelligence operations, sir, but they are interlinked and mutually supporting. So, all Army and AFP operations are intelligence-driven, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, it's possible that intelligence funds were spent by the AFP in regard or in relation to these activities?

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Your witness, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: from there.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ang tanong ko po, balikan ko lang po yung tanong. Di po ba kanina nasabi nyo na ilang dekada na po kayo dyan sa Zamboanga Peninsula?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ang tanong ko lamang po kung merong ahensya ng gobyerno na magkoconduct ng intelligence or confidential information sa area ninyo, meron po bang SOP na dapat sundan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Vague, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Vague, incompetent.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What's your response, Atty. Rey, to the objection?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Your Honor, it's a simple question, Your Honor. If there is an SOP followed by military units.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, the witness already mentioned that he is not an intelligence officer. I'm not talking about...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If he knows, counsel, if he knows. If he doesn't, then let that be his response. Colonel Boransing, you may answer, sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. I... I wouldn't know, sir, because, again, sir, I'm not an intelligence officer. I'm

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: a civil-military officer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: May coordination po bang ginawa yung DepEd noong umano'y nag-conduct sila ng intelligence or confidential information noong 2023 sa area ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Pleading, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Reform counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So, meron po bang SOP pag magko-conduct ng operations sa area ng isang Kagayan yung division ng Army.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Leading, leading, Your Honor, as you've answered.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: So, what

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: is the SOP, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Just to get over the hump, counsel, please reform. What is the

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: SOP, sir? As you've answered, Your Honor. Wala pang sagot, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'll allow it, counsel. Again, just to get over this hump.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yes, sir. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: I don't know, sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: It's not my field of expertise, sir. Again, I'm an infantry operations officer and a civil-military operations officer. It's a completely different field, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: We submit, sir. We will move on to another point.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Is there a chance you will finish your direct, counsel, before lunch?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: I'll try to finish, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly do so. Kindly try to do so without pressuring you, counsel.

turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor, Sir.

turns.speaker: Col. Manaros M. Boransing II
turns.text: These youth leadership summits are usually conducted in high-threat areas. because these students and out-of-school youth are usually the target of recruitment for violent extremism. turns.text: Our infantry units are conducting security operations to ensure that our participants, the activity is not attacked. And of course, the intelligence units also conduct intelligence operations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: We're not willing to stipulate, Your Honor, because according to the certifications, and three of those I have read earlier, the certifications were issued page by page for whatever legal purpose it may serve. And therefore, when the AFP officers issued the certification, they did so with eyes wide open that this will be used for whatever legal purpose it may serve under the original document.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Let me clarify, Atty. Sheila, that at the time they issued the certification, they were not aware that it will be used as an attachment in DepEd's response.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: I'm sorry, Your Honor. No stipulation on that point, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Then you can just concentrate on that point, Atty. Ray.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Another point for possible stipulation. Yes. That the witness will testify that they did not receive any information about any confidential information from the DepEd being...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Well, if he knows, counsel, I'm sure Attorney Sheila is not willing to stipulate on that.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Certainly no, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So you have two points.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: That's a

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: conclusion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So make your offer on those two points. At least it abbreviates the proceedings.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly make your offer. Hold on. The clerk of court is directed to kindly place the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Just one final point, Your Honor. Is counsel willing to stipulate that the witness appeared during the hearing on October 17, 2024 before the Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: May I know which witness, Your Honor? The four witnesses that he stated earlier?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: All of them.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Boransing, Panopio, Bajao, and Sangdaan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Sangdaan. That's fine, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So stipulated, noted.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly place the witness under oath. Yes, Atty. Sheila?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: May I ask that Atty. Lindon Miguel Bacquel be again recognized?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Atty. Lindon. See you again. Kindly place the witness under oath.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Please raise your right hand. You, Magtangol Panopio, do swear that the evidence you shall give. In the case now pending, between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte, shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help you God.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I do.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: May I ask the clerk if the witness was informed of the court's earlier ruling on the hearing device while he was waiting?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Colonel Panopio, you are not allowed to bring a cellular phone or any form or... or any form of hearing device while you are testifying before this impeachment court so that there will be no coaching in regard to your testimony.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Do

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: understand that, sir?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I understand, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Your offer, Attorney Ray?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. I will limit it to the points still in dispute.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: On the two points.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. We are presenting the testimony of the witness to prove that he issued

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: a certification dated December 5, 2023, regarding the conduct by his unit of youth leadership summit and information education campaign within the area of their operations. And that at the time he issued the SED certification, he was not aware that it's going to be used by the Department of Education for the purpose of liquidating the expenditure of confidential funds particularly for the payment of rewards in the amount of 15,540,000 pesos and that the witness did not receive or is not aware of the receipt by him or by his unit of confidential information supposedly gathered by the Department of Education in relation to their conduct of the Youth Leadership Summit and Information Education Campaign in 2023.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lindon, subject to cross?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Colonel Panopio, base po sa mga records na pinagkasunduan na ng prosecution at ng counsel for the respondent, naisama po dun sa sulat ng dated April 17, 2024 ng Department Education yung certificates dated December 5, 2023 na in-issue nyo tungkol doon sa YLS at IEC activities ng inyong unit noong 2023 para umano i-liquidate. ang paggastos ng confidential funds ng Department of Education ang maabot sa halagang 15,540,000 na umano'y pinambayad ng rewards. Ang tanong ko po sa inyo, when for the very first time did you learn of this fact?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Please clarify, Your Honor, yung pong paggamit ng confidential funds o pag-liquidate, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Alam niyo po ba, kailan niyo po nalaman na ginamit yung dokumentong in-issue niyo? para dun yung certification na inisyo n'yo pang-liquidate.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Your Honor, nalaman po namin yan nung nagharap kami sa Congress nung nagkaroon po ng congressional hearing tungkol sa Confidential Intelligence Fund ng Department of Education, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Kailan po 'yun kung maalala n'yo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Sometime 2024,

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Pag pinakita ko po ba sa inyo yung transcript ng stenographic note, Noong hearing na yon, makikilala niyo po ba kung doon o sa ibang petsa, ginanap yung hearing na yon?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Opo, makikilala ko po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Attorney R.J., Your Honor, we are confronting the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would you like to stipulate, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: I believe that this has already been stipulated earlier.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Already stipulated, counsel, that he testified. Okay. So...

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: ang tanong ko po, ang sabi po niyo, noon sa unang pagkakataon, nyo lamang nalaman na ginamit yung certification nyo pang-liquidate ng confidential funds. Ano po yung naging reaction nyo nung nalaman nyo yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Vague, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Colonel Panopio, the date of the hearing is October 17, 2024. So doon n'yo po unang nalaman.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Na ginamit yung inyong certification bilang isa sa mga liquidation documents ng DepEd sa COA AOM.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Doon ko lang po formally nalaman yung information na yun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Did you have any reaction, Colonel, upon hearing or knowing that?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Medyo nagulat po kami kasi yung po ang aming certification is only for the certification that we conducted the Youth Leadership Summit. Hindi po namin sinacertify anything about money or funds, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That's your answer, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ano po ang paliwanan? o dahilan na binigay sa inyo, kung meron man, kung bakit ginamit sa ganun paraan ng DepEd yung certification niyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Vague, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: It's clear, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If he knows. Do you know? Did DepEd ever explain to you why they did that?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I think, Your Honor, I can't answer for the DepEd. I can only answer for our office, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So you don't know?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I don't know, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: tanong ko po, may kaugnayan po ba? Ano po ang kaugnayan? noong certification na in-issue nyo doon sa paggasta ng DepEd ng confidential funds na naghahalagang 15,540,000 pesos noong 2023, di umanoy sa pagbabayad ng mga rewards.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Reaction, Your Honor. Witness is incompetent to answer the question. The question is speculative and it calls for an opinion, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Ray, I would have to sustain the objection. Witness would be incompetent to answer that question. Kindly modify or move to another point.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Yung pong sino

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: po sa DepEd ang nag-coordinate sa inyo noong 2023 para ipaalam sa inyo ang resulta daw noong kanilang confidential operations sa area niyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. No basis, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: I'm asking the witness, Your Honor, if there is anyone from the DepEd who gave them that information.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, I'm constrained to sustain the objection, counsel. Attorney Lindon is correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly reform, modify, or move to another point.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Sino po ang humingi? Sino po ang nagpa-issue sa inyo noong certification na in-issue niyo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yung po certification ay in compliance with the order of my commander to issue certifications to DepEd in coordination with then USEC Nolasco Mempin, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So tama po ba sabi n'yo? Inutusan kayo? Inorderan kayo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: It is part of my job as the Assistant Chief of Staff for Civil-Military Operations to issue certificates to our partners, especially on activities conducted by the division, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: What explanation was given to you? When you were asked to issue that certification.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Vague, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: It's clear. If he knows.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Explanation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: If he knows.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If you know, Colonel.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Our activities in the Armed Forces of the Philippines takes collaboration with other agencies. So it is, I think, normal for our agency to issue certifications that such activities happen in collaboration with different agencies of the government, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: So ano po ang para saan po? yung pag-issue nyo ng certification na iyon.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Ang certification na ito po ay nagpapatunay na yung mga Youth Leadership Summit ay totoong na isakatuparan sa aming area of operations during the year 2023, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Bukod pa rin, meron pa uho bang ibang dahilan kung bakit nyo inissue yung certification?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: As far as I'm concerned, Your Honor, ang alam ko lang po ay pagpapatunay na ang mga activities ng Youth Leadership Summit sa area ng 7th Infantry Division ay naisakatuparan sa taong iyon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ano po ang kaugnayan nung certification na in-issue nyo dun sa umano'y pagbabayad ng reward ng DepEd gamit ang confidential funds? Kung mayroon man.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: No basis, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If he knows, counsel.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I have no information on that, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Anything else?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: I think that will be all for the witness, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Nothing to cross, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There being no cross, any senator-judge who wishes to make an interjection? Senator-Judge Lacson.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thereafter, our Senate President, then Senator-Judge Hontiveros.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Follow-up lang po doon sa tanong ko kanina kay Colonel Boransing. Kasi hawak ko rito yung dalawang certifications. One issued by Lieutenant Colonel Panopio. Now, full-Colonel ka na, no?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Okay. The other, issued by Lieutenant Colonel Sangdaan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Parang merong paragraph dito, yung specifically the second paragraph, parang template. Ito. This collaborative, ito yung sa iyo ah, this collaborative efforts with the DepEd and the local government units were conducted. Sa kabila, this collaborative efforts with the DepEd were conducted to insulate the students, were conducted to insulate the students from recruitment, tong kabila, from exploitation, tapos, and inform them of the ills of terrorism and communism, and inform them of the ills of terrorism and communism. Nag-uusap pa kayong dalawa?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yung pong mga, Your Honor, yung pong mga term na yun ay commonly na ginagamit namin sa military. So more or less, magkataparehas po kami ng wordings, Your Honor. Pero hindi po kami nag-usap ni Colonel Sangdaan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: I'm just wondering, that's why I want it clarified. Kasi kanina tinanong ko si Colonel Boransing, siya yung nag-craft ng language. Yung sa kanya, in fairness, iba. Pero napansin ko lang sa inyong dalawa, parang nag-copyahan kayo.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I think, Your Honor, we are following the doctrine and format of our report because it is written in the YLS handbook. and all other activities, Your Honor. Halos magpaparehas po talaga yung mga statement.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Pag-issue ng certification?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I am not aware of the certification of Fifth Infantry Division, Your Honor. I'm just aware of the certification of the Seventh Infantry.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Well, I'm telling you, it is almost similar. It's almost a template. Kaya nga ako nagtatanong, dahil bakit yung kay Colonel Boransing iba? Entirely different.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, sir. Maybe because we are... Near with 5th Infantry Division, we are adjacent unit with 5th Infantry Division and the 7th Infantry Division.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Dahil magkapit-bahay kayo.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. In Region 2 and Region 3, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Just to remind our senator-judges that we will try to adjourn today by about 2.30 so that we can convene the session at 3 according to the Senate President. The Senate President is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Magandang hapon, Colonel.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Colonel, meron dito, binabasa ko yung certification na ibinigay niyo at dito sa third paragraph nakasulat dito the identification of the areas where these summits are to be conducted was made possible through the information we primarily got from DepEd and goes on and then Sa next sentence, also because of this exchange of information, we were able to perform our civil-military combat and intelligence operation in our AOR with a focus on protecting the schools. Nasa screen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Colonel, anong ibig sabihin nitong information? Ito ba ay confidential information, surveillance information na nanggaling sa DepEd?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Your Honor, when we conduct YLS, we are following different phases. During the planning phases, we are coordinating with different agencies like the LGUs, the schools, and the community kung saan po namin kakandakin yung YLS. So, yung pong information na galing sa iba-ibang agency ay tumutulong sa amin upang i-determine saan po namin kakandakin specifically. yung Youth Leadership Summit, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pero dito sa inyong letter, itong galing sa DepEd, ito ba ay confidential information or surveillance information?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: The information given to...

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yung galing sa DepEd lang ah, based on dito sa letter n'yo. This is in relation to the YLS and the IEC.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: May I clarify, Your Honor, but when you say na galing sa DepEd, I assume that it came from the teachers on the ground as members of the DepEd who provided us the information on how and where to conduct the YLS, Your Honor. So I think yung information na ito ay masasabi natin na somehow meron pong confidential or meron din pong open source. But based on experience, it is mixed, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Saan galing ito primarily from DepEd? Itong DepEd, napakalaking organization. May teacher, may superintendent. So itong we primarily got from DepEd, saan siya galing? Sinong personality?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. During collaborations in the ground, Your Honor, different teachers as a teaching force in different schools, doon po kami nakikipag-coordinate. So I think the teachers on the ground, are the personalities being mentioned in that certification, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So in this particular certification, in relation to the YLS saka IEC, teachers ang tinutukoy nyo dito?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Wala ng iba?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Walang principal, walang superintendent, walang regional director?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: As to the direct and specific person being coordinated, I cannot say it is teachers only but I cannot speculate but More or less, they are coordinating to different levels from higher to lower echelon of the school, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dito sa certification na ito, from higher level all the way to down?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: At meron kayong personal information na higher level all the way to the teachers?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kayo mismo, kasi kayo gumawa ng certification. I want to understand what went into this certification.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: In the ground, Your Honor, there are different levels of coordination. For example, yung pong mga battalion commanders, company commanders, and platoon leaders, they will coordinate directly on the ground while those who are in the higher echelon of command, they might coordinate to the district supervisor or even the higher levels to coordinate the conduct of YLS, Your Honor. Ibig sabihin po, may kanya-kanya pong level ng coordinations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: And itong mga information na binibigay sa inyo, anong klaseng information?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Nasabi niyo kanina, may open source, may confidential. Ano bang klaseng information ang binibigay sa inyo to conduct itong dalawang activities?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Your Honor, yung mga information usually, kung ano po yung nangyayari sa community. Halimbawa, on ills of the, yung pong HADR or di kaya yung parenting, and then meron din po sa terrorism and communism. Iba-iba po. Meron din pong drug abuse and other family matters, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: And these are confidential information? Yung binibigay sa inyo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: It is an open source information because it is known in the community. So I cannot determine whether it is confidential or open regarding na lang po ito sa pag-take ng recipient or... kung sino pong nagbigay ng information, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kanina nabanggit niyo na merong open source, may confidential. Ano yung confidential na kukuha niyo? Nagaling sa DepEd, ha? I'm particularly in sources, DepEd lang.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Siguro po yung mga, I can speak it only, Your Honor, maybe the personal circumstances like teenage pregnancies or other personal informations na maging confidential because it is their personal life, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So, it's about the personal life of the students. Yun ang example niyo.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, that's my example only, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay. And then, paano niyong ginagamit itong mga confidential information na galing sa DepEd in your selection of schools for the two activities?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Pinaplano po namin yan kung saan po may mataas na mga pangangilangan niyong community. And of course, this is only in collaboration with the LGUs. Pag may nag-request po ng LGUs, we will conduct the YLS in that particular area. Because it is a planned activities of the divisions, specifically on our AOR, but we will ascertain kung saan pong lugar kung mayroong request yung LGUs or other government agencies, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator-Judge Hontiveros is recognized. You have two minutes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer, at magandang hapon po, Colonel.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So sir, ginamit din po ng DepEd yung certification ninyo para i-liquidate yung paggastos nila di umano ng kanilang confidential and intelligence funds. May sinabi po ba ang certification ninyo tungkol sa kung paano ginastosan ng DepEd yung mga YLS at saka ibang activities nila?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Hindi po sakop ng certification namin yung area na yun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ibig sabihin, hindi sakop ng certification nyo yung area ng ano yung ginastos ng DepEd para sa mga YLS at iba pa?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. About sa conduct of activity only, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay, so tungkol lamang sa conduct of the activity.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, bilang signatory dun sa certification, may pinatutunayan ba kayo doon? tungkol sa kawastusan ng paggastos ng deped ng kanilang confidential and intelligence funds?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I think wala pong pinapatunayan sa paggastos ng pera, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: It is only stating that we conducted the YLS in our area of operation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So simpleng ang certification ay may laman na may... dinaos na ganitong mga gawain. Wala pong sinasabi kung paano o anong pondo ang ginastos ng particular ng DepEd dyan, whether regular funds nila or confidential and intelligence funds nila. Wala po yun sa certification.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Wala po yun sa certification, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright po. So, to confirm... Muli, finally, Colonel, wala po kayong alam na sinabi doon sa certification tungkol sa paggastos ng DepEd sa confidential and intelligence funds dyan sa mga gawain ng YLS at saka IEC campaign activities.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Wala po yun sa certification ko, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Colonel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Hontiveros. Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo. Again, sir, kindly be mindful. We're trying to convene at three.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Three quick questions lang po. Colonel, yung activities ninyo, YLS, IEC, I know this is centered on community relations, di po ba? Not to gather information but to win the hearts and minds of the community. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright. So wala po talagang kayo idea. It's not intelligence gathering.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: It is not, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: It is not.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Then, did you ask any intelligence unit in your division na baka sila po ang nag-feed ng information sa DepEd against anti-insurgency? Could it be possible? Or na baka may mga student leaders na member po ng ikang insurgence? Would you happen to know? Did you ask?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: May I clarify that question, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Question is, Did you bother to ask kung hindi po kayo nag-feed ng intel info sa DepEd? Baka sila nagbibigay ng info para sa mga estudyante na they believe na member ng mga insurgency groups?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I can only speak for the civil-military operations activities, Your Honor. Yung pong activities ng intelligence community, they have their own, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Tama po. So, I was just asking, sir, baka kung alam mo na baka nagko-coordinate din sila sa intelligence units. But you said na you don't know. Panghuli na lamang po, sir, can you confirm ba na or would you happen to know, sir, the difference between a confidential fund and intelligence fund?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: With respect to the topic for the day, I don't have any idea, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: You don't have any idea between the Confidential Intelligence Fund. Well, sir, Confidential Fund is a fund to be used by a civilian agency, not military, not police, to gather information. Your Intelligence Fund po used by the AFP and the PNP to gather intel information for national security. All right. Yun na lamang po. Maraming salamat, Mr. Witness, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo. Senator-Judge Raffi,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You have 10 minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Magandang hapon po, Colonel.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Gano'n po kayo tagal nagpa-participate sa YLS?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Noong, as staff, Your Honor, or as an officer?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: It doesn't matter, as staff, or officer, sige, as officer.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I've been participating in YLS for quite some time, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yung quite some time?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Mga more or less, mga, say, five years, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Five years. So, before BP Sara, ang naging Deputy Secretary, nandoon na kayo, opisyo na kayo ng YLS at nagpaparticipate na kayo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kumusta naman yung mga naging YLS ninyo at that time before BP, Sara, ang Deputy Secretary?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I can say that our YLS is successful because we're able to gain the or finish the or attain the objective of YLS which is insulating the youth from illegal activities and building their intelligence and being a nation builder, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Very good. So, ibig sabihin successful even before the time of Sara as the Deputy Secretary sa mga previous. So, inabutan mo yung previous Deputy Secretary?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sila ba ay nagpa-participate din doon sa YLS program ninyo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you very much.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Raffi, Senator-Judge Villanueva. Then, Senator-Judge Hontiveros again. Again, a kind reminder to our colleagues and Senator-Judge Pangilinan with one question after Senator-Judge Hontiveros. Kindly proceed, Senator-Judge Villanueva.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Sir, Colonel Panopio, same question po kay Colonel Boransing. Naalaman niyo po kung bakit kayo pinag-i-issue ng certification at binanggit po ba yung purpose?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Katulad po ng sagot ka kanina, it is our, I think, normal duty to issue certificate as to the conduct of activity because we are collaborating with different government agencies, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ulitin ko po yung tanong ko. Alam niyo ho, yung purpose nung hiningan kayo ng certification, sinabi sa inyo, ito yung purpose para hingan ka ng certification. Wala pong sinabi.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Wala pong sinabi, Your Honor. Specifically.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you. Colonel, regardless kung ano yung designation niyo, noong nag-issue po kayo ng certification, noong nag-issue po kayo, did your actual duties in issuing that certification include collecting, analyzing, validating, or disseminating intelligence-related information?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: As CMO officer, we are only gathering and collecting information in relation to civil-military operations, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: So it's just that? no analyzing, validating, disseminating intelligence-related information.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: None, Your Honor. It is only for civil-military operations, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yes, that is when you issued the certification. Pero nung hindi po kayo nag-issue ng certification, ito ba parte ng trabaho niyo? Ginagawa niyo po ito?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: As civil-military operations officer, some of that, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yes, kasi na-encounter kita sa Commission on Appointments. We confirmed you and dun sa PIR mo, it shows yung iyong intelligence officers basic and advanced courses. So nakita ko lang po dito. Colonel, when you signed itong certification covering yung three youth leadership summits involving 205 students, were you certifying only that those AFP activities were conducted and not, because you're not aware, let me know if you are aware, and not that DepEd paid rewards or informers or that information supplied by informers caused those activities to succeed.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Dahil wala po kayong alam doon.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Lastly, Colonel, given those limitations, would it be correct to say that your certification, standing alone, cannot establish the factual basis for the 15.54 million pesos reported by DepEd as rewards to informers. It cannot stand alone.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I think it has no relation with my certification, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: It has no relation. That's why it cannot stand alone. There must be supporting documents, other supporting documents to support it.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I can only speak for the certification that I issue, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: But are you aware that it will be used by the department to... to be part of their liquidation report to the Commission on Audit?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: But kung alam mo na gagamitin, would you say it does not suffice?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, it will not suffice, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you. That'd be all. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Villanueva. Before Senator-Judge Hontiveros, Senator-Judge Pangilinan to avail of his first round. Senator-Judge Pangilinan, you may proceed, sir, with your, as I understand, singular question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: One question, pero baka may follow-up ng isa pa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Magandang hapon, Colonel Panopio. Kayo ba ay taga Pampanga o kapampangan ba kayo?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I'm from Batangas, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Ah, Batangas. Kasi may mga Panopiong mga kapampangan. Anyway, tinanong ko ito kanina kay Colonel Boransing, yung usapin ng paggasta ng confidential funds at yung security officer ng DepEd. si Colonel Dennis Nolasco. Merong ba kayong pakikipag-usa, pakikipag-ugnayan, pakikipag-coordinate kay Colonel Nolasco sa usapin ng paggasta ng confidential funds doon sa mga YLS o kaya IEC?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Ako personally, Your Honor, wala po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Now, at ang nakipag-usap sa inyo ay si

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: former, former

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: general siya, di ba? Mempin, no? Si USEC Mempin ang nakipag-usap para hilingin yung certification ninyo.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Siya po yung nakipag-usap sa division commander, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, and your division commander relayed to you the request of USEC Mempin about the certification of the IEC and the YLS.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. So, just for the record,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Claro na yung security officer ng DepEd na kung saan, base sa dating testimonya, ay siya ang humawak. Sa kanya nilipat ang confidential funds. Hindi nakipag-usap sa inyo.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Sa akin po personally, hindi, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No other questions. Thank you, Senator-Judge Pangilinan, Senator-Judge Hontiveros. Again, for hopefully singular question as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer. Just one topic but three quick questions within it.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Magandang hapon pong muli, Colonel. Ka-follow up po sa tanong ni Senate President kanina. So, dati na pong ginagawa yung mga activities na to, YSL, IEC, campaign activities, at dati rin na

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: po kayong nagko-coordinate sa mga teachers on the ground, tama po?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright, sir. And nagbibigay naman po sa inyo, sa Army, ng information silang mga DepEd teachers kahit po noong wala pang confidential funds ang DepEd noon. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: About the confidential fund, I have no knowledge, Your Honor, but they are already coordinating with us, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Mula pa sa nakaraang mga taon o kahit dekada na nagdadaos ng ganitong mga gawain ang Philippine Army.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright, sir. So, huli na lang. E tumigil po ba sila, yung mga teachers on the ground, na mag-coordinate sa inyo noong nawala na yung confidential funds ng DepEd?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: I think on the ground, tuloy-tuloy naman po ang coordination ng teachers with the EAP, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Hanggang sa ngayon po, Colonel.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright. Salamat pong muli, Colonel. Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much, Senator-Judge Hontiveros. Colonel Panopio, thank you for your time. Maraming salamat po sa... Ah! Senator-Judge Lacson is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Very quickly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: My apologies, Colonel Panopio, we're not yet done.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Yeah, very quickly. Anong S-bracket ng YLS participants?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Basi po sa aming document, it's from 15 to 30 years old, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Hindi ba 18 to 30?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Based on our record, it's 15 to 30, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: So mostly mga college students ito?

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: High school and college student, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Ah, magkahalo.

turns.speaker: Col. Magtangol G. Panopio
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Lacson. Kung wala na po, maraming salamat po sa inyong panahon, kooperasyon at pagtugon sa mga katanungan, Colonel Panopio, ng mga abogado mula sa magkabilang partido, gayon din mula sa mga miyembro ng hukumang ito. At maraming salamat din po sa inyong serbisyo sa ating bansa. You are excused, sir, and thank you for your time. Thank you, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before I recognize the parties, just to dispose of some administrative proceedings. Court directs the Clerk of Court to continue with the parties the marking of additional exhibits at the Recto Room later at 4 p.m. The Chair likewise directs the Clerk of Court to furnish the parties initially with USB copies of the submissions of the banks after it was reviewed by the Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And we also have hard copies. So we will be turning over the hard copies as well. It's a bit voluminous, but I'd rather that you keep your copies, we keep our copies, and all of the copies due and owing to you be given to the parties. The Clerk of Court is so directed. And number three, to clarify, Honorable Luistro, tomorrow you shall be presenting Attorney Poa and Ms. Grande. That would be correct? For the record, the Honorable Luistro is nodding. Yes, Attorney Sheila, anything?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Just one quick question, Your Honor. I just want to know the order of the presentation tomorrow. Will the prosecution present Attorney Poa first or the PSA representative?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Luistro, may you please respond?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: To respond, Your Honor, we will be presenting first Attorney Michael Poa and if we will be able to conclude earlier, we will be presenting as well the PSA representative, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I presume that we can do that.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you for that information, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Anything else? If that is all, there be no other matter or business to be taken up. Trial is hereby adjourned until 10 a.m. tomorrow, Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Session will be called according to the Senate President, still at 3 p.m.
